youtube.title: Why Fireflies Glow Without Getting Hot ✨ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A firefly produces light through bioluminescence. A chemical called luciferin reacts with oxygen, helped by an enzyme called luciferase, and the reaction releases almost all its energy as visible light. A normal incandescent bulb, by comparison, turns most of its energy into heat.
